title: Binding Server to localhost (127.0.0.1) instead of 0.0.0.0
symptom: Build passes successfully and container starts, but the public URL returns '502 Bad Gateway' or 'Connection Refused' or healthcheck times out.
explanation: Inside a Linux container, `localhost` (127.0.0.1) is loopback only within the isolated network namespace. External requests forwarded by the Zerops ingress load balancer cannot reach the process unless the application listens on `0.0.0.0` (all network interfaces).
proTip: Ensure the port number in your code matches the port declared in `zerops.yml` exactly!

title: SPA Routing 404 on Page Refresh (React / Vue / Vite)
symptom: Home page (`/`) loads fine, but clicking navigation to `/about` or `/dashboard` and hitting browser refresh (F5) results in a 404 Not Found error.
explanation: Single Page Applications (SPAs) use client-side routing (like `react-router-dom`). When a user visits `/about`, the web server looks for a physical directory named `/about/index.html` on the server disk. Since it doesn't exist, static web servers return 404 unless configured to rewrite all unknown paths to `index.html`.
wrongCode:
# Incorrect static setup in zerops.yml (missing routing rewrite)
zerops:
  - setup: frontend
    build:
      base: nodejs@20
      buildCommands:
        - npm run build
      deployFiles:
        - dist
    run:
      base: static
      # Missing index.html fallback for client-side routing!
fixedCode:
# Correct zerops.yml with static fallback
zerops:
  - setup: frontend
    build:
      base: nodejs@20
      buildCommands:
        - npm install
        - npm run build
      deployFiles:
        - dist/~ # Note: '~' deploys contents of dist directly
    run:
      base: static
      # In Zerops static service, add custom nginx rewrite if using static nginx
      # or ensure routing fallback is configured for SPAs
proTip: Using `dist/~` in deployFiles deploys the contents of `dist` directly into the root web folder rather than creating a subfolder `/dist`.

title: Hardcoding Database Credentials & Localhost URLs
symptom: App crashes on startup with 'Connection to postgres://localhost:5432 failed' or authentication failure.
explanation: In production cloud environments, databases run in separate isolated containers with dynamically generated credentials and network hostnames. You cannot connect to `localhost:5432` from your API container.
proTip: Zerops automatically resolves `${db_hostname}` variables across linked services in your project.

title: Slow 10-Minute Builds Caused by Missing Cache Directories
symptom: Every code change takes 5-10 minutes to build because `npm install` or `pip install` or Go modules re-download from scratch on every single git push.
explanation: By default, build containers are ephemeral (destroyed after build). Without caching directives in `zerops.yml`, the package manager cannot reuse previously downloaded packages.
wrongCode:
# Slow build without cache
build:
  base: nodejs@20
  buildCommands:
    - npm install
    - npm run build
fixedCode:
# Fast build with cache enabled
build:
  base: nodejs@20
  buildCommands:
    - npm ci
    - npm run build
  cache:
    - node_modules
    - ~/.npm
proTip: Adding `cache: [node_modules]` drops Node.js build time from 3 minutes down to under 15 seconds!

title: Mismatch Between setup Name in zerops.yml and Service Hostname
symptom: Deploy fails immediately with error: 'No configuration found for service [service-name] in zerops.yml'.
explanation: In `zerops.yml`, the `setup:` identifier must EXACTLY match the hostname you gave to the service when creating it in the Zerops dashboard.
wrongCode:
# In Zerops dashboard, you created a service named 'myapi'
# But your zerops.yml has:
zerops:
  - setup: api # MISMATCH! Zerops cannot map 'myapi' to 'api'
fixedCode:
# Matches the dashboard service name 'myapi' exactly:
zerops:
  - setup: myapi
    build:
      base: nodejs@20
      ...
proTip: If your project has multiple services (e.g. `frontend` and `backend`), list both under the `zerops:` array in a single `zerops.yml` file!

title: Healthcheck Failing or Timing Out on Heavy Startup
symptom: Container boots up and works locally, but Zerops marks the deployment as FAILED and rolls back with 'Health check timed out'.
explanation: Zerops sends HTTP requests to your configured health check URL (e.g., `/` or `/healthz`) to verify readiness. If your app takes 10 seconds to run database migrations before listening, or if the health route returns a 401 Unauthorized or 404, Zerops assumes the container crashed.
zeropsYmlCheck:
run:
  ports:
    - port: 3000
      httpSupport: true
  healthCheck:
    httpGet:
      port: 3000
      path: /healthz
proTip: Keep `/healthz` lightweight and unauthenticated so Zerops load balancers can probe container health constantly.

title: Using devDependencies in Production Build or Missing Production Build Command
symptom: Deploy fails during build with `tsc: command not found` or `vite: command not found` or app crashes in runtime with `Cannot find module 'express'`.
explanation: If TypeScript or build tools are needed to compile your code, they must be in `dependencies` or installed during the build stage before `npm prune --production` is executed.
wrongCode:
# Deploying without building TypeScript or running dist
run:
  start: ts-node src/index.ts # ts-node is slow and requires dev dependencies in runtime!
fixedCode:
# Compile TypeScript in build phase, run compiled JS in run phase
build:
  base: nodejs@20
  buildCommands:
    - npm ci
    - npm run build # Compiles src/ to dist/
  deployFiles:
    - dist
    - package.json
    - node_modules
run:
  base: nodejs@20
  start: node dist/index.js
proTip: Always test running `npm run build && node dist/index.js` locally before pushing to production.
